verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a managed data-pipeline SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Fivetran events such as sync completion or failure. The only webhook-related item (fivetran-docs-47) describes sending data to an endpoint as a source for ingestion and its usage cost, which is inbound data collection, not event subscription. 'Fivetran Alerts' is a dashboard feature with no documented programmatic webhook delivery, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
